items.title: Google Gemini Privacy Controls Bypassed to Access Private Meeting Data Using Calendar Invite
items.description: A significant vulnerability within the Google ecosystem allowed attackers to bypass Google Calendar’s privacy controls using a standard calendar invitation. The discovery highlights a growing class of threats known as “Indirect Prompt Injection,” where malicious instructions are hidden within legitimate data sources processed by Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.
